# Dr. Nahlah Implants and Prosthodontics Specialists

> Implant dentistry and prosthodontics in McLean (Tysons Corner) and Alexandria, Virginia, led by board-certified prosthodontist Dr. Esam Nahlah: dental implants, All-on-4 full arches, full-mouth reconstruction and cosmetic dentistry, with an in-house digital laboratory.

- Specialist: Dr. Esam Nahlah, DDS, MS, board-certified prosthodontist (Diplomate, American Board of Prosthodontics; Fellow, American College of Prosthodontists), adjunct faculty in the Virginia Commonwealth University Prosthodontics Postgraduate Program. [Profile](https://www.drnahlah.com/meet-dr-nahlah)
- Sedation offered: nitrous oxide and oral sedation only. The practice does not offer IV sedation or general anesthesia.
- Free second opinions on implant surgery. A five-year warranty on implant and cosmetic work, conditional on six-monthly Precare cleanings.
- Payment: Cash, Check, Credit card (most major cards accepted), Dental insurance (most PPO plans), Third-party financing (CareCredit, Proceed Finance, LendingClub).
